verdict.rationale: The docs mention a Management API for programmatically managing xAI API teams and short-lived 'ephemeral tokens' for client-side/agent use to avoid exposing full API keys, which is a narrow least-privilege mechanism, but there is no documentation of scoped/role-based API key permissions (e.g., read-only, tool-restricted, or per-agent scopes) for general agentic use. Missing for 10: explicit scoped-permission API key creation, role-based access control documentation, and any agent-specific credential-scoping guidance beyond the narrow ephemeral-token use case.
